name: procurement-intelligence
description: Procurement intelligence: Next.js web app, Node/Express/MongoDB API, and a Semantica graph service

scripts.test: npm --prefix services/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test && uv run --directory services/graph pytest -q
scripts.lint: npm --prefix services/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix services/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.contracts: npm --prefix services/api run openapi && npm --prefix services/api run export:graph-seed && npm --prefix apps/web run types:api
